tool_args.rationale: The mobility bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the five observations at a single sink gradient cannot determine its gradient response or resolve the branch term. The open-branch probe directly tests those ambiguities.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the two-layer siphon bridge immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so the sink inhibition and branch mechanism are not independently identifiable.
The mobility-bridge and flux-conservation signatures favor a static siphon; a trajectory batch is less targeted to the present ambiguity.
These remain alternatives, but also require varying the sink gradient to distinguish them from the bridge model.
